blocks.raw: <Warn>Do not confuse the Project Construction Cost (PCC) with the Total Project Cost (TPC). The PCC is the cost of the physical construction work. The TPC includes the PCC plus professional fees, permits, land cost, financing costs, and other project costs. Professional fees are typically calculated as a percentage of the PCC, not the TPC.</Warn>
